footer.tagline: Oman’s marketplace for affordable used cars, in Arabic and English.

promise.bandText: The whole site sits in one price band. Nothing above OMR 6,000 is listed.
promise.priceText: Listed prices are the real asking price, not bait to start a call.
promise.specText: Every listing says which it is. It changes what a car is worth here.
promise.whatsappText: Message whoever is selling the car directly. No middleman, no call centre.

notice.noAccounts: There is no account system yet, so there is no password to change. The rules below are the ones that will apply when there is.

profile.title: Edit profile
profile.notice: Accounts are not switched on yet, so nothing on this page is saved. It is here so you can see exactly what a buyer will be shown about you before we turn it on.
profile.photoHint: PNG or JPG, square, up to 4 MB. A smaller file loads faster for buyers on mobile data.
profile.detailsHint: Your name and WhatsApp number are shown on every car you list. Buyers contact you on WhatsApp in one tap, so a wrong number means no calls.
profile.aboutPlaceholder: A line or two about yourself — buyers see this
profile.passwordHint: Change your password on its own page.

addListing.title: Add a listing
addListing.draftFound: You started a listing on this phone and did not finish it.
addListing.resume: Pick up where I left off
addListing.stillNeeded: Still needed before this can go live:

car.intro: Five questions. Everything a buyer scans first, and nothing else.
car.kmHint: km, not miles. The odometer reading as it is today — a buyer will check it against your photo.
car.derivedTail: We build the title from the year, make and model so every listing on Autosouq reads the same way — no capitals, no exclamation marks, nothing to decode.

spec.heading: Spec and paperwork
spec.originHint: State this honestly. A US or Japan import is not worth less on Autosouq — buyers here expect them and price them in. What loses you the sale is a buyer finding out at the viewing.
spec.originRequired: Required — a listing with no spec stated is shown to buyers as “Spec not stated by seller”, in amber, which is the one thing that makes an honest car look evasive.
spec.mulkiyaHint: بطاقة الملكية — the expiry printed on the registration card. An expired mulkiya means the buyer faces an ROP inspection before they can drive it, so saying so up front saves both of you a wasted trip.
spec.lienLegend: Is the car under a bank lien? (مرهونة)
spec.lienHint: A car with a lien on it cannot be transferred at the ROP counter until the loan is settled. Buyers find this out at the counter; it is better that they find it out here.
spec.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Leaving Oman in September / bought a bigger car for the family
spec.work: What has been replaced or repaired recently?
spec.workPlaceholder: e.g. New tyres and battery in March, AC regassed, timing belt done at 180,000 km
spec.faultsPlaceholder: e.g. AC weak on hot days, dent on rear door, front tyres will need replacing soon
spec.faultsHint: A buyer who reads about the dent before they drive to Sohar still trusts you when they arrive. Saying “nothing that I know of” is a claim you are making — which is the point, and it is what makes it worth something.

price.label: Asking price ({currency}) *
price.asIs: Under {threshold}, listings are published with the “{label}” label — no warranty, no returns, buyer inspects before paying. The label is set by the price, not by you, and it is not a mark against the car.
price.ok: Inside the band. Put the real number here — the price a buyer sees is the price they expect to pay.
price.compareLink: See what other cars are listed for on Autosouq
price.compareTail: — the same page a buyer is looking at. We do not publish a valuation or a “good price” badge, because we do not have the sales data to earn one.

photos.intro: Photos are what a buyer judges the car on. Take them in daylight, with the car clean and the background clear.
photos.shrinkHint: Each photo is shrunk to about 1,600px on your phone before it goes anywhere, so uploading ten of them costs you a fraction of the data the originals would.
photos.notSwitchedOn: Photo upload is not switched on yet. These stay in this browser and are not part of the saved draft — if you close the tab you will need to pick them again.
photos.asItIs: Photograph the car as it is
photos.asItIsHint: Including the dents and the scratches. A buyer who sees the damage before they drive out to you is a buyer who still trusts you when they arrive.
photos.shot1: Front three-quarter — the whole car at an angle
photos.shot5: Dashboard with the odometer reading visible
photos.shot8: Every dent, scratch or patch of rust

contact.notice: Your WhatsApp number is shown on your listing and buyers tap it to message you directly. Autosouq does not sit in the middle and does not see your chat.
contact.whatsappHint: It is how nearly every buyer will contact you, so check it twice.
contact.invalid: That is not an Omani mobile number. WhatsApp needs a number starting 9 or 7, eight digits — a landline will not work.

review.heading: What buyers will see
review.moreHint: None of this is needed to publish. Add it if a buyer would ask.
review.vinHint: 17 characters. Adding it lets a buyer run their own history check — the easiest trust you can offer.

addListing.bandNote: Autosouq lists cars from {stdMin} to {max} only. Cars from {asisMin} to {asisMax} are accepted but are published with a “{label}” label. Anything above {max} we cannot publish — that is the whole point of the site, not a limit we can lift.
